headers.description: Optional: Bearer <api_key>:<api_secret>, the agent's API credential (also accepted as X-API-Key or x-provian-api-key; it does not expire and is bound to one wallet). The public reads get_agent_record and get_pvt_estimate need no credentials. create_wallet is DISABLED on this remote endpoint (a stateless request cannot safely retain a fund-bearing key): a hosted agent generates its own key in its own runtime and creates the wallet it owns with wallet_challenge + wallet_create (public key and signature only), then reconnects with the returned credential. A PROV- link code is never a credential.
headers.name: Authorization
